comment: The literal secret patterns shared by the TypeScript redactor (cli/src/ui.ts) and the Rust sidecar-stderr redactor (core/src/bin/nexus_tui/redact.rs). Patterns are JavaScript regular-expression source and are also valid Rust `regex` syntax; the Rust side spells case-insensitivity as `(?i)`. `replacement` uses $1-style groups. Rules run in this order. `scope: all` rules must appear in redact.rs verbatim and in the same order (cli/test/redaction_parity.test.ts fails otherwise); `scope: multiline` is applied to whole text in TypeScript and, line by line with state, by `StderrRedactor` in Rust. Add a pattern here, add it there, and add a case to cli/test/fixtures/redaction_corpus.json.
